# saml-cipher

> A pure-Python interactive cryptographic toolkit providing modern symmetric ciphers, hybrid post-quantum cryptography (PQC), and user-friendly CLI workflows.

saml-cipher aims to make robust encryption accessible to all users through interactive command-line interfaces (powered by `questionary`) while supporting cutting-edge cryptography—including Post-Quantum Cryptography (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) ready for Q-Day.

## Core Features & Ciphers

- [X25519 + ML-KEM-768](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/x25519mlkem768): Hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation combined with ChaCha20-Poly1305. Designed to resist Shor's algorithm (Q-Day ready) and side-channel attacks on mobile devices.
- [ML-DSA-65 (mu)](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/mldsa(mu)): Post-quantum digital signature scheme (ML-DSA with message updates) for long-term document and data integrity.
- [AES-256-GCM + Argon2id](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/aes_gcm_argon2id): Authenticated encryption with Argon2id password-based KDF, featuring dynamic memory scaling to balance security and system resources against GPU brute-force attacks.
- [X448](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/x448): High-security elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange (Curve448) coupled with ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption.
- [RSA 4096-bit](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/rsa): Asymmetric RSA encryption utilizing PKCS#1 OAEP padding and ChaCha20-Poly1305 for hybrid high-speed file encryption.
- [DES CTR](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/des): 64-bit DES in CTR mode. Marked as INSECURE; strictly provided for educational and legacy research purposes.

## Quick Start & Usage

- [requirements.txt](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/blob/main/requirements.txt): Core dependencies including `cryptography`, `pycryptodome`, and `questionary`.

### Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher.git
cd saml-cipher
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Execution
Run the respective script inside its cipher folder to enter interactive CLI mode:
```bash
python aes_gcm_argon2id/aes_gcm_argon2id.py
python x25519mlkem768/x25519mlkem768.py
python rsa-file-encrypt.py
```

## Security Notices

- **Test Keys**: Embedded test keys across RSA, X448, and DES use default password `test`. NEVER use test keys in production environments.
- **DES Notice**: DES is cryptographically broken and should never protect sensitive data.
- **PQC Recommendation**: For long-term data security against quantum decryption (Harvest Now, Decrypt Later), prefer `x25519mlkem768`.
